title: FTSE Russell June 2027 reconstitution lock-down begins — membership freezes, weights do not
source: EST: rule-derived from the index owner's ground rules, with the Monday convention now confirmed against SEVEN published instances across BOTH schedule regimes, and the date reached by TWO independent derivations that agree. GROUND RULES, re-fetched and text-extracted independently this session (2026-09-06): FTSE Russell, "Russell US Equity Indexes" construction and methodology, v7.2, August 2026 (lseg.com dam PDF, HTTP 200, 746,491 bytes, 77 content streams inflated in-session; the cover's own version string read back as "August 2026 Construction and Methodology ... v7.2"). Appendix F's June column: Query Period = "For two weeks following preliminary announcement", Lock down = "Three weeks after query period ends"; the same appendix defines what the date means -- "During lock down, the Russell US index semi-annual reconstitution is considered final, and any additional changes are made in exceptional circumstances only, in accordance with the FTSE Russell Recalculation Policy and Guidelines". DERIVATION 1 (from the preliminary date): two weeks after the 2027-05-21 preliminary announcement is Friday 2027-06-04, and lock-down begins the following MONDAY, 2027-06-07 -- prelim + 17 days, which holds 4 of 4 in the current regime. DERIVATION 2 (from the implementation date, which removes the preliminary date from the estimate chain entirely): lock-down Monday = implementation Friday - 18 days in the current regime, and 2027-06-25 - 18 = 2027-06-07 -- also 4 of 4. Both derivations return the same Monday, so this entry rests on TWO links (implementation date, offset), not three. THE MONDAY CONVENTION IS CONFIRMED AGAINST SEVEN INSTANCES, each read this session off FTSE Russell's own schedule press release for that year: 2020 lock-down Mon 06-15 (prelim 06-05, impl 06-26), 2021 Mon 06-14 (06-04, 06-25), 2022 Mon 06-13 (06-03, 06-24), 2023 Mon 06-05 (05-19, 06-23), 2024 Mon 06-10 (05-24, 06-28), 2025 Mon 06-09 (05-23, 06-27), 2026 Mon 06-08 (05-22, 06-26). All seven are Mondays; all seven are the Monday after the query period ends. CORRECTION TO THE PROPOSAL THAT CARRIED THIS ID: the proposal confirmed the convention against 2023-2026 only and described it as "two weeks after the preliminary announcement, then the following Monday". That rule is REGIME-SPECIFIC and fails on 2020-2022, which ran a ONE-week query period -- applied cold it would put 2021's lock-down at 06-21 against the owner's published 06-14. What is stable across all seven years is the Monday-after-query-end convention; what changed in 2023 is the query period's LENGTH (one week to two), alongside the announcement window (three weeks to five). The offsets are therefore prelim+10 / impl-11 for 2020-2022 and prelim+17 / impl-18 for 2023-2026. The owner's 2019 schedule press release names NO lock-down date at all (rank day 05-10, prelim 06-07, updates 06-14 and 06-21, implementation 06-28), so 2019 is deliberately excluded rather than reconstructed from a rule the owner had not yet published. Filed estimate because it rests on a rule-derived implementation date (2027-06-25) and no FTSE Russell 2027 reconstitution calendar is published until roughly 2027-03 (the owner's own cadence: 2019-03-01, 2020-03-03, 2022-03-02, 2023-03-01, 2024-03-01, 2025-03-03, 2026-03-02), and because this calendar's confirmed-tier source prefixes have no member for an index owner. This is an unpublished document, not a blocked fetch. Promote on the published 2027 schedule naming the lock-down date, once a prefix exists for it. Canonical file written by this event's own never-assessed initial research, checked 2026-09-06
notes: CANONICAL FILE written by this event's own never-assessed initial research (2026-09-06), which found the id existed only as proposals/russell-recon-lockdown-2027-06-07.from-russell-recon-preliminary-2027-05-21.json; that proposal was read in full first and its findings are carried forward, not discarded. WHAT THIS DATE ACTUALLY IS, from a ground-rules clause no sibling in this chain had read -- §6.4.1, verbatim: "For merger and spin-off transactions that are effective between rank day and the business day immediately before the index lock down takes effect ahead of the reconstitution, the market capitalizations of the impacted securities are recalculated and membership is reevaluated as of the effective date of the corporate action. For corporate events that occur during the reconstitution lock down period (which take effect from the open on the first day of the lock-down period onwards), market capitalizations and memberships will not be reevaluated." So lock-down is a HARD CUTOFF for corporate-action-driven membership revision, in force from the OPEN of 2027-06-07 -- not merely an administrative label. And it freezes MEMBERSHIP, not weights: the owner's 2024 schedule release states the lock-down leaves "any further changes to shares and free float isolated to changes associated with corporate matters", and the owner keeps posting updated lists AFTER lock-down every year (2026: 12 and 18 June against an 8 June lock-down; 2023: 9 and 16 June against a 5 June lock-down). MEASURED THIS SESSION on seven owner-sourced lock-down Mondays (2020-2026), and the results split cleanly. THE DAY ITSELF IS THE EMPTIEST DATE IN THE WHOLE RUSSELL CHAIN: IWM-vs-SPY session excess on the lock-down Monday is +0.013% mean, +0.034% median, 4 of 7 positive, one-sided bootstrap p=45.3% against -0.0125% unconditional; IWM volume 1.11x trailing-60d median, above 1.0x in only 4 of 7. That null is what theory predicts and is the reason this entry is worth carrying: lock-down is the one date in the chain that releases NO information (it is on the owner's published calendar from March, and finalises a list published three weeks earlier), so it is a natural PLACEBO for any future claim of a Russell effect. The placebo panel proves the point -- two of six shifted Mondays (-14d and +14d) cleared p<0.05 while the real date sat at p=45.3%. THE WINDOW IS A DIFFERENT STORY, AND UNACTIONABLE: lock-down close to implementation close returns IWM-vs-SPY negative in 6 of 7 years (median -1.15%, one-sided sign test p=6.3%), but the full-sample MEAN is +0.04% because 2026 alone printed +6.91%; ex-2026 the mean is -1.10%. Sign and mean disagree, the implied trade is short IWM against SPY, and shorting is blocked house-wide. THE ONE POSITIVE RESULT IN THIS CHAIN IS A VOLUME RAMP: IWM's mean daily volume ratio steps from 0.97x median over the query window to 1.16x over the lock-down window (higher in 6 of 7 years, sign p=6.3%, sign-flip permutation p=8.6%), against the sibling's 0.90x on the announcement's first tradeable session and 1.33x on implementation day. Turnover in this chain is driven by CERTAINTY, not by information -- the information day is the quietest, and volume only builds once the list can no longer change. 2027-SPECIFIC CONFOUND: 2027-06-07 sits inside the 2027-05-29 to 2027-06-10 FOMC blackout and two sessions before fomc-2027-06-09 (high), so any 2027 lock-down-day flow read is confounded at the source -- the same class of problem opex-2027-05-21 creates for the announcement date. Impact low, status estimate: no shares move on this date, no house playbook is index-flow- or calendar-keyed (re-grepped 2026-09-06 for rebalanc|index effect|reconstitution|russell|lock-down, zero hits), shorting is blocked house-wide.
